tool.name: CreateClassificationMap

param.name: classified_raster
param.dialogReference: Raster containing classification results, typically output from the Predict Landcover or Apply Majority Filter tools. Each pixel should contain an integer value representing its landcover class. The tool will apply classification symbology to visualise different classes with distinct colours.

param.name: class_names_file
param.dialogReference: JSON file containing class names and descriptions (generated by the training tool). If not provided, the tool will search for "class_names.json" in the raster's directory and parent directories (Specified during model training).

param.name: map_title
param.dialogReference: Title for the map layer. This name will appear in the Table of Contents. Default: "Landcover Classification".

tool.summary: Add a classified raster to the current ArcGIS Pro map with proper symbology, class names, and RGB colour assignments. The tool automatically applies appropriate colours to land cover classes and creates a legend with descriptive class names
tool.usage:
Use this tool after creating a classification with the Predict Landcover tool. Optionally provide a class names file to label classes with descriptive names instead of numeric codes.The class names file should be a CSV with two columns:

  • Column 1: value (numeric class code)

  • Column 2: name (descriptive class name)

Example:

  • value, name

  • 1, Forest

  • 2, Water

  • 3, Urban

  • 4, Agriculture
